body.statement: Does there exist an explicitly parameterized relatively open subset of \(\mathcal M_0(2)\) and \(\eta>0\) such that every law in the subset satisfies \(q(X,\{Y\})/2-q(Y,\{X\})\ge\eta\) and \(H(X,\{Y\},Y)>0\)? Equivalently, can the rare-component smoothing handle produce an interior-positive support-closed identifiable ANM for which the wrong order \((Y,X)\) is a strict insertion-local maximizer of the exact \(\alpha=1\) score?
body.justification: A strict open trap would distinguish failure of this hybrid optimization score from failure of causal identification.
body.gap: Neither Li et al. (2025) nor Reisach et al. (2023) construct a robust smooth wrong-order local maximum for GENE Equation (6).
body.consumer: Method developers obtain a concrete stress-test family for deciding whether a different neighborhood or score is required.
